description: This source file implements utility functions for distributed store synchronization in PyTorch Elastic, including context managers for timeout, methods for obtaining and synchronizing data across nodes, and barrier synchronization mechanisms using a distributed key-value store.

methods.name: store_timeout(store, timeout: float)
methods.description: Sets a temporary timeout on a store object within a context manager, restoring the previous timeout on exit.

methods.name: get_all(store, rank: int, prefix: str, world_size: int)
methods.description: Retrieves data from a distributed store for a range of keys with a common prefix and ensures all processes have finished collecting data.

methods.name: list[bytes] synchronize( store, data: bytes, rank: int, world_size: int, key_prefix: str, timeout: float = 300, )
methods.description: Synchronizes multiple agents by setting data in a store, then retrieving all data, ensuring consistency across distributed processes.

methods.name: _try_detecting_missing_ranks
methods.description: Detects which ranks have failed to check in within a specified timeout, used during barrier synchronization.

methods.name: str _barrier_nonblocking(store, world_size: int, key_prefix: str)
methods.description: Implements the non-blocking part of barrier synchronization using a store-based increment and last member indicator.

methods.name: None barrier( store, world_size: int, key_prefix: str, barrier_timeout: float = 300, rank: int | None = None, rank_tracing_decoder: Callable[[int], str] | None = None, trace_timeout: float = 10, )
methods.description: Performs a barrier synchronization across processes, optionally tracing missing ranks in case of timeouts.
